title: What's New: Get Notified of Issues with Job Queues (2024 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Role Center Task Tiles and Visual Indicators
External Notifications with Business Events and Power Automate

features.name: Job Queue Notifications
features.description: Business Central can notify users in product or through external channels when critical background processes stop or fail. Administrators can set up who gets notified, how they are notified, and how frequently notifications are sent.
caveats: External business events feature is in preview

features.name: Job Queue Notification Assisted Setup Guide
features.description: A guided setup experience that walks administrators through three steps: selecting notification recipients, choosing notification methods (in-product or external), and setting notification frequency thresholds.

features.name: In-Product Notification Strip
features.description: Users see a notification strip in their role center when background processing tasks fail or experience issues. The strip allows users to show more details, inspect failed tasks, restart jobs manually, and disable notifications via My Settings.

features.name: Job Queue Task Tiles in Role Center
features.description: Three additional queue tiles show job queue task status: tasks failed, tasks in progress, and tasks pending or waiting. Visual indicators using color-coded queues reflect admin-configured thresholds for failed tasks.

features.name: Job Queue Notification Administrator Role
features.description: Designated users can be set as job queue notification administrators who see their own job queue tasks and can also access and view job queue tasks and statuses of other users, allowing centralized monitoring.

features.name: External Notifications with Business Events
features.description: Notifications can be sent to users outside of Business Central by orchestrating business events through Power Automate. A power automate template is available that can send emails to Outlook when job queues fail.
features.status_evidence_quote: this part of the feature is uh currently in preview mainly because the business events are uh still in preview
caveats: Depends on business events being in preview

features.name: Job Queue Entry API
features.description: New API for job queue entries that includes a restart bound action that can be called automatically from Power Automate flows, enabling programmatic job restarts.

features.name: Job Queue Log Entries API
features.description: New API for accessing job queue log entries, enabling external systems and flows to retrieve detailed information about job queue execution history.

features.name: Job Queue Task Failed Business Event
features.description: Business event that triggers when a job queue task fails, enabling integration with external systems through Power Automate and other connectors.

features.name: Power Automate Template for Job Queue Notifications
features.description: Pre-built Power Automate template available in Business Central gallery for orchestrating external job queue notifications, with built-in parameters for environment, company, and recipient configuration.

features.name: Notification Frequency Thresholds
features.description: Administrators can configure notification thresholds to avoid notification fatigue for transient issues. For example, notifications can be set to trigger only after 3-5 consecutive failures rather than on every failure.
